Messages.Author: François
Messages.Body:
Hello,

In a round of combat, several mandatory presses are waiting to be
resolved. What rules determine which one is used first ?

For instance, at the beginning of a combat between Lorrie Dunsirn and
vampire X, some player plays Frenzy on X. Which press (frenzy's or
Lorrie's) is applied first ?

The answer will determine if the combat will have either two or three
rounds...

Thank you !

- François

Messages.Author: LSJ
Messages.Body:
François wrote:
> In a round of combat, several mandatory presses are waiting to be
> resolved. What rules determine which one is used first ?

The controlling Methuselah decides which of her combatant's mandatory presses is
used first.

> For instance, at the beginning of a combat between Lorrie Dunsirn and
> vampire X, some player plays Frenzy on X. Which press (frenzy's or
> Lorrie's) is applied first ?

The "this round has a press" applies before Lorrie can use her press.
The Frenzy is not a mandatory press in the usual sense, because it isn't from
either of the combatants -- it simply is.
